asset_boundary.runtime_note: Character and enemy visuals stay on local recorded open/free sources; VFX in this file are Godot shapes, tweens, particles, and color parameters.

buses.note: Phase 0 keeps BGM/SFX bus gain at 0 dB so the existing per-node volume_db mix does not regress; spec_target_volumes_db applies once per-node gains migrate onto buses. Sub-buses (MusicExplore/MusicCombat/MusicStinger, SFXPlayer/SFXEnemy/SFXWorld, ReverbZone) arrive with audio_director in phase 1 (spec 20260726160400000 section 5.1/6.3).

sfx_catalog.catalog_note: Event keys follow the naming contract in spec 20260726160500000 section 6.8. Entries with status local_audio are wired today (implemented_in points at the runtime function; runtime_key is the legacy key inside that script's SFX/AUDIO table). Entries with status future_free_candidate are contract slots awaiting free-license assets.
